headline: EPS collapses both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Yasunaga reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥0.55, down 97.6% q/q and down 97.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥0.55 fell 97.6% sequentially from ¥22.93 and 97.2% year-over-year from ¥19.99. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
